result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear data-rendering defect stands out: a restaurant card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' row shows '€NaN delivery', indicating an undefined/missing delivery fee value was passed into currency formatting and rendered as NaN.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee data before formatting; provide a fallback (e.g., 'Free delivery', '€0 delivery', or hide the fee line) when the value is null/undefined, and fix the upstream data source or parsing that produces NaN.
